retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1970s studio photograph featuring exaggerated platform footwear, rainbow textiles, and interlocking script typography with a glowing airbrushed finish.
triggerTerms: rainbow striped socks with feathered heels
interlocking script logo with airbrushed glow

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition centered on a leg wearing a rainbow-striped sock and a massive wooden platform shoe adorned with multi-colored feathers, set against a soft-gradient studio backdrop with stylized script lettering at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical leg acts as a central axis for the composition.
The wood grain of the shoe contrasts with the soft texture of the feathers.
The interlocking script typography mirrors the curves of the leg and shoe.
The rainbow colors of the sock are echoed in the feathered trim.
coreInvariants: Exaggerated wooden platform heel with visible vertical grain
Feathered or fur-like texture on the shoe strap

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The leg and shoe occupy the central vertical third of the frame, extending from the top edge to the bottom surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive wooden platform heel resting on a reflective dark surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the rainbow sock down to the feathered shoe, then moves upward to the glowing script logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Neutral gradient space on the left and right sides provides breathing room for the complex central subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm wood tones and neutral grey-blue background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant rainbow stripes (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow script with a white glowing highlight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject against a desaturated, mid-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or digital-looking colors; stick to 1970s dye-based saturation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with interlocking descenders and flourishes.
letterConstructionRules: Continuous monolinear stroke with rounded terminals
Ascenders and descenders that wrap around other letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' and 'H' are oversized with exaggerated swashes
The 'y' and 'g' have loops that cradle adjacent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly decorative custom script paired with a minimal, widely-spaced sans-serif for balance.

preserve: Wide tracking of the bottom text
avoid: Tight tracking on the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, rounded 70s vibe but requires manual interlocking.
Appropriate for the wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a leg in a rainbow sock and a feathered wooden platform shoe on a dark reflective floor against a grey-blue gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom interlocking script lettering at the top with a yellow fill and a soft white airbrushed glow; add widely spaced sans-serif caps at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the platform shoe have a vertical wood grain?
Is there a starburst glint on the lettering?
Is the bottom text widely spaced?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital gradients; use soft airbrushed transitions.
Ensure the platform shoe height is exaggerated to 70s disco proportions.

mustAchieve: Fluid, hand-drawn quality in the script

postGenerationChecks: Check for wood grain texture on the heel.
Verify the rainbow sock colors are distinct.
Ensure the script lettering has a soft outer glow.
Confirm the bottom text is centered and widely tracked.
Check for the reflective quality of the floor.
recipe.reuseFormula: 70s Studio Photography + Rainbow Hosiery + Wood Platform + Interlocking Script Logo
